personality: 3 Editorial structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A calm, elegant, and precision-driven workspace that frames creative content with high-end editorial typography and cinematic glass surfaces.

typography.guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond exclusively for top-level headers (H1/H2) and prominent empty states. Use Geist for all body, labels, metadata, and buttons. Cap font weight at 500 across both families; rely on size and the serif vs. sans contrast to establish hierarchy.

spacing.rule: Drastically increase whitespace. Apply 3xl padding between major vertical sections. Use md or lg for internal component padding. Prevent content from crowding screen edges (always lg or xl outer margins). Do not let lists or grids feel cramped.

do's: Use subtle glassmorphism (expo-blur) on the bottom tab bar, floating actions (FAB), and sticky headers.
Apply frosted glass overlays behind text that sits on top of media/project thumbnails.
Ensure a translucent tinted base (≥70% of surface color) sits behind the blur for readability.
dont's: Do not apply glass to generic input fields, standard list rows, or body text regions.
Do not stack more than two blur layers on a single screen.

screens.name: Dashboard & Projects List
screens.purpose: A calm, cinematic overview of recent projects and core metrics.

states.loading: Premium skeleton state: use a subtle, slow-pulsing surfaceTertiary opacity animation on large structural blocks, no generic spinners.
states.empty: Cinematic empty state: an elegant abstract graphic with a brief Cormorant Garamond headline and a single gold CTA button.
states.error: Minimalist text message with a 'Retry' text button; no heavy red banners.

screens.layout: Increase padding heavily. Use a top header with glassmorphism. Represent projects as large edge-to-edge (minus screen padding) cards. Use a 2-column grid only if imagery is extremely prominent, otherwise default to spacious single-column list. Remove heavy borders; define cards using surfaceSecondary against the surface background. For active states/hover, use a 0.98 scale press animation.

screens.name: Project Editor (Tabs)
screens.purpose: The core workspace for film/video metadata and assets, prioritizing precision and readability.

states.loading: Staggered skeleton rows matching the tab content structure.
states.empty: Subtle placeholder icon centered in the tab view with a single-line directive.

screens.layout: The tab bar should feel like a premium segmented control (no clunky bounding boxes, just text with an active gold indicator). Forms in Overview/Script should be single-column with Geist labels above inputs. Eliminate all visible borders from inputs; use surfaceTertiary with a subtle radius for fields. Display Storyboard grids with absolute precision, utilizing 1px subtle dividers if necessary rather than wrapping cards in shadows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the styling of a premium SaaS application (like Linear, Frame.io). Do not introduce any new workflow steps or features.

Refine the Typography Hierarchy: Use Cormorant Garamond ONLY for top-level Display headings (H1/H2). Use Geist for all UI elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, lists). Never use font weights above 500; achieve hierarchy through font-size and the serif/sans contrast.
Increase Whitespace & Layout Calmness: Apply 3xl (48px) and 2xl (32px) vertical spacing aggressively between distinct page sections. Let the UI breathe.

Minimize Borders and Shadows: Remove heavy borders from inputs and cards. Use surface color contrast (e.g., surfaceSecondary on surface) and very subtle borders (0.5pt max using 'border' token) to define boundaries. Eliminate all heavy drop shadows; default to shadow_tier 1 or 0.

Refine Interactions: All buttons and interactive cards must implement a premium 0.98 scale-down on press. For web hovering, use a subtle opacity shift or background lighten instead of aggressive border changes.

Implement the Gold / Ink Brand Accurately: Map the existing #C5A059 (Gold) to the brandPrimary token and #232333 (Ink) into the dark mode surface/surfaceSecondary tokens. Avoid using the gold indiscriminately; use it solely for primary actions, active indicators, and high-level accents.

Apply Glassmorphism thoughtfully: Introduce expo-blur layered over a translucent tint (surface at 70% opacity) for sticky headers, tab bars, and bottom sheets to give it that native Apple HIG / Premium SaaS depth.
